title: Very good tour
text: We toured with Francesco and he was very good. We toured all three places. Francesco couldn’t come up to the tower as guides are not allowed but he dropped us off at the entrance. We didn’t use headsets which it notes in the brochure. There were only two of us so there was no problem hearing him. We enjoyed all three places
author: DotsGirl2

title: Guided tour of the monuments of Seville. Giralda Tower, Seville Cathedral and Real Alcazar
text: Guided visit to the 3 most iconic monuments of the beautiful city of Seville, with the accompaniment of Guia Carmen, who surprised us for their sympathy and professionalism, so it makes sense to visit monuments with someone who dominates their knowledge of history, thank you for everything Carmen and I will recommend you! See you soon! Carla Marques and Gilberto Neto - Figueira da Foz - Portugal
author: 599gilberton

title: A journey in a beautiful world in search of our origins
text:

author: Jose F

title: Good value for money!
text: Well organised very informative tour of the Cathedral Alcazar and Giralda! Our tour guide Mercedes was exceptional. She had great knowledge and a lovely manner with the group making it fun and interesting. She was also very good at keeping us safe and together which was no mean feat when in the busy areas!  Highly recommend this tour .
author: Sue N

title: Super Seville
text: Had a great time with Miguel who led us through the Alcazar and Cathedral, past everyone else from our ship and right to the relevant areas- he really knows his way around and we were able to get maximum impact for the time we had from the ship. Loved every minute and will do it again when next in Seville.

author: Carole_R

title: Cathedral and Real Alcazar Tour with Laura from AndalSur
text:
We spent four hours with Laura, touring the Cathedral of Seville and the Real Alcazar Palace in Seville. This was the best four hours of the week we spent in a Spain! 

Because we had a tour guide we were able to bypass the very long line to enter each building. And Laura’s knowledge of the history and architecture of both sites was amazing!  Seeing these awe-inspiring structures through the lens that Laura was able to provide was simply amazing!  We would not have had the same experience if we had toured the Cathedral and the Alcazar Palace on our own.
author: Grace R

title: Visit Alcazar and Cathedral
text:
Despite the large influx of people to Seville this bridge and the difficulty that this entails for access to monuments and visits , our guide Leonardo managed to make everything more enjoyable and more bearable for his treatment and explanations, also sacrificing some of his time to finish our visit as it should. This is why I think it is highly recommended.
Thank you very much Leo, very grateful.
author: Angel A
